# TOML Language Basics

This syntax-only VS Code extension provides TOML language detection, bracket
configuration, and TextMate grammars for Echo Code. It has no extension host
entry point or language server, so editing a TOML file does not start a
background process or request a remote schema.

The language configuration and grammars come from Even Better TOML 0.21.2 by
Ferenc Tamás. They are redistributed under its MIT license in
`LICENSE.md`.
